title: LMLitho: A Large Vision Model-Driven Lithography Simulation Framework
problem: Lithography simulation is computationally expensive, slowing design validation and optimization for advanced technology nodes.
motivation: Fast, accurate lithography simulation enables rapid design iteration and advanced-node preparation.
method: Large vision model trained on 100k lithography patterns for simulation. Vision transformer architecture for pattern-to-output mapping. Generalizes to advanced technology nodes beyond training data.
key_novelty: First large vision model-based approach to lithography simulation achieving 120x speedup over commercial tools.
limitations: Accuracy compared to commercial tools at advanced nodes not quantified; model portability to different lithography processes unclear.
